lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense array of circular high-luminance blobs is visible posterior to the gill slits, following a semi-regular grid-like distribution across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible intersecting with the circular blobs, particularly in the region between the lateral ridge and the pectoral fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper flank, defined by a high-contrast transition between a light dorsal edge and a shadowed ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small yellow fish (likely a pilot fish) near the posterior flank and several dark elongated remora-like shapes attached to the ventral area behind the pectoral fin.
